notes: NCBI StatPearls Granulosa Theca Cell Tumors was reread for sex cord-stromal origin, estrogen production, postmenopausal bleeding/endometrial effects, inhibin positivity, nuclear grooves and Call-Exner bodies.
Endotext ovarian physiology was reread for the two-cell/two-gonadotropin model: LH stimulates theca androgen production and FSH induces granulosa-cell aromatase to generate estrogen.
NCBI MeSH independently confirms estradiol and inhibin secretion by granulosa cell tumors.
USMLE Step 1 specifications were verified for Reproductive and Endocrine Systems with foundational physiology distributed by disease process.

blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

duplicate_gate.rejected_candidate: Familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia was rejected because Q0573 already covers CASR loss-of-function and hypocalciuric hypercalcemia.
duplicate_gate.diagnosis: Adult granulosa cell tumor of the ovary

claim_audit.tumor_identity: Call-Exner bodies, grooved nuclei and inhibin positivity support adult granulosa cell tumor.
claim_audit.endocrine_effect: Granulosa cell tumors can produce estrogen and cause postmenopausal/abnormal uterine bleeding and endometrial proliferation.
claim_audit.normal_granulosa_function: FSH stimulates granulosa-cell aromatase/CYP19 expression; granulosa cells aromatize theca-derived androstenedione to estrogens.
claim_audit.theca_distractor: LH-stimulated theca androgen synthesis supplies substrate but does not itself represent the granulosa-cell function producing the estrogenic endometrial effect.
claim_audit.dht_distractor: 5-alpha-reductase generates DHT and does not explain estrogen excess.
claim_audit.adrenal_distractor: 21-hydroxylation is adrenal steroidogenesis and unrelated to granulosa tumor hyperestrogenism.
claim_audit.leydig_distractor: Leydig-cell cholesterol steroidogenesis is male gonadal physiology and not the cell of origin.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A postmenopausal estrogenic syndrome with an inhibin-positive ovarian sex cord-stromal tumor and Call-Exner bodies identifies granulosa cell tumor. The normal cell function that directly creates excess estrogen is FSH-stimulated aromatization of theca-derived androgens.
adversarial_second_pass.estrogen_vs_inhibin_challenge: Granulosa tumors often secrete both estrogen and inhibin. Inhibin suppresses FSH but does not directly cause endometrial hyperplasia; estrogen does.
adversarial_second_pass.theca_cell_challenge: Theca cells make androgen substrate under LH, but the question asks for the tumor cell of origin's normal function; granulosa aromatization is therefore uniquely correct.
adversarial_second_pass.foXL2_challenge: FOXL2 mutation is a major adult granulosa tumor driver, but the lead asks about the physiologic function that explains the endometrial phenotype, not the oncogenic mutation.
adversarial_second_pass.menopause_challenge: Normal postmenopausal ovaries have low granulosa activity; the tumor is autonomous neoplastic tissue that can retain steroidogenic function, so menopausal status does not negate estrogen secretion.
adversarial_second_pass.cueing_check: All options are genuine steroidogenic or reproductive cellular functions and are parallel in style.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: No frequency of FOXL2 mutation, estrogen secretion rate, inhibin cutoff or endometrial-cancer incidence is needed.
